Hello,
Thank you so much for your trust and positive feedback!
Lots of cuddles to your pet!
The veterinary team.

I just called at 6:15 PM. A woman with a strong African accent literally hung up on me without warning while I was explaining that my dog ​​was literally dying. This person hung up and left me facing my despair, even though she heard me praying for my dog. I'm in Sète, and no one is answering, nor in Montpellier. I called the Lyon emergency room four times; they also slammed the phone down on me. They're the ones who are still in debt for years to save my daughter, my mirage. You cost me €15,000. No, I want to know, and I want you to explain how it is that at 6:20 PM, I don't want to degrade my dog. I don't know her level; I imagine she's a third-year apprentice. Despite her, Laurence couldn't think of anything better to do than hang up on me and put me through to the standard system. The difference between platforms is that I called at 6:15 PM on a Saturday because there was no one there on Sunday, and your apprentice, who thinks he's the King of England, is moving forward. What kind of service is this?
We recently moved to the neighborhood and wanted to find a vet nearby.  Staff was very friendly and the clinic was immaculate. Dr. Dorte was amazing and spoke English to our very bad French!
Well-equipped premises, good reception and efficient team.

Dr. Werquin took care of my son, Pimousse, for five years. He always took the time to explain everything to me simply, effectively, and above all, understandably. Dr. Werquin is a wonderful person and a truly competent professional!

I mustn't forget his assistants, who do a remarkable job. Always smiling and, above all, equally competent in their field! I'm returning to my native South and I hope to find another Dr. Werquin there. Thank you so much for everything.
The team was perfect for our kitten, very attentive, understanding, and caring. Our kitten received excellent care. A huge thank you to them again. We highly recommend this clinic.
Kindness and cleanliness

We just discovered this clinic for our two cats' and dog's annual check-up and vaccinations.
It was absolutely fantastic! The vet was wonderful with all our animals.

My Golden Retriever is quite apprehensive about vets, and I felt he was treated with such gentleness and respect! So even though he was stressed, it was very manageable, even for him!
Perfect team, the follow-up is very professional, we thank the whole team for their support.
The staff and vets are very friendly and professional, I highly recommend them! ✨
Very pleasant veterinarian. Beautiful, welcoming premises. Lovely reception.

I was able to get an appointment online on a Sunday afternoon for the following morning. My cat was first seen by Mr. Dorte, the veterinarian, who examined him carefully and took the time to explain the situation to me simply and clearly, while showing great compassion for my concern.

The veterinary assistant was also extremely kind and supportive. My cat was then hospitalized at the clinic for about 48 hours. I was able to call several times a day for updates on his progress and was also invited to visit him at any time outside of opening hours—which was particularly appreciated. The treatments provided were clearly explained to me, as well as their purpose. I sincerely thank the entire team for the quality of care and their professionalism.

I found a dog today on the banks of the Rhône River in the hands of a homeless couple… I immediately knew it wasn't theirs. They told me they had found it… I took it in and went to this veterinary clinic.
I spoke with Chloé, who helped me find the owner and kindly trimmed D'jango's (that's his name) claws because they were very long.

Then she did everything she could to contact the owner of this poor lost animal, left to fend for itself! A huge thank you to you!

My little Chanel was treated at this clinic until her death in December at the age of 14. I have no complaints about the care she received, but the reception from one of the two assistants was simply appalling: unfriendly, unkind, and completely lacking in empathy, even though my dog ​​was very ill and I had spent a considerable amount of money...
However, the second assistant was wonderful, always smiling and attentive... Thank you to her 🙏
Best vets in Lyon 👍🏼 …
Fast and efficient service. My Vet Lyon Brotteaux listens to animals and takes great care of them!
Excellent welcome, competence and service.
Friendly welcome despite the wait. However, a €46 fee for a health certificate to catch my flight... I find that really outrageous... On Avenue Berthelot I paid €15... anyway... what a shame

I'm giving one star because I can't give less. I should point out that my four dogs are all treated at the same clinic (you can imagine that, financially, I'm a good customer).
I was called in for an emergency at noon and given an appointment for 4:30 PM. When I arrived, there was no appointment noted and no more slots available. The only response was: "I'll pass on the error. We don't have any openings until Monday." For a serious paw infection, the wait could be life-threatening... I find this unprofessional. I'm a business owner: when you make a mistake, you take responsibility for finding a solution, whether at the end of the day, between appointments, or during a break. I don't know, but you don't politely respond with "figure it out yourself."

Because of the wait, no other veterinarian had any availability. I was forced to go to the emergency veterinary clinic. I hope this comment will help you correct your future mistakes, and I do not thank you for the waste of your time and money.

I've had my two dogs treated by Dr. Werquin since I arrived in Lyon, five years ago. He's a good professional in whom I had complete confidence. I lost my first dog in May, and following his death, my little dog developed kidney failure, …
Having recently adopted a cat, we chose one a little bit at random, but we are absolutely not disappointed, we highly recommend it!
